s050.sec5.u0: I have to guard this place.
s051.sec57.u1: Heh heh... ha ha... So you came after all!
s051.sec57.u3: I am Devimon! A fallen angel, enthralled by the power of darkness. Heh heh heh...
s051.sec57.u5: Myotismon is somewhere in the mansion. Probably still alive, too.
s051.sec57.u7: Who knows? But I am your enemy. That much is certain.
s051.sec57.u9: Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha!
s051.sec57.u11: Heh heh... Give Myotismon my regards.
s051.sec57.u12: He got away... Dang it! What a creep.
s051.sec57.u15: Nobody here? Or is the place too big for them to hear me?
s051.sec57.u16: Oh well. Okay, let's start exploring!
s051.sec81.u0: It won't open... A mysterious power has sealed it.
s052.sec83.u0: It won't open... It's locked. And there's no keyhole!
s054.sec5.u0: You have helped us many times. Allow me to share the fruits of my research. It seems that when MetalGreymon dies in battle or of illness, he can sometimes become SkullGreymon. Others can Digivolve this way as well: Bakemon, Devimon, Phoenixmon... From what, I cannot say. The Digivolution charts will not show you such Digivolutions, so do commit this to memory.
s054.sec5.u1: Since my men began to fight in the Arena, they have been returning to their old selves. It seems to do them a world of good. And a bout in the Arena between my studies makes a fine change of pace for me, too.
s054.sec5.u2: What IS this research of his, anyway...?
s054.sec5.u3: Myotismon, they've opened an Arena in the city!
s054.sec5.u4: Hm. Do you think my men could be of use there?
s054.sec5.u5: You bet! Let them go wild!
s054.sec5.u6: My men are getting worse and worse... It may be only a matter of time before they leave this mansion.
s054.sec60.u2: Perhaps you would hear what I have to say.
s054.sec60.u4: Lately my men have stopped doing as I say. They are not rebellious... they simply seem to forget their orders entirely. Sometimes they do not even understand them in the first place. Now, my meals are supposed to be brought to me by my men, but...
s054.sec60.u6: While I was absorbed in my research, no meals came at all... and I was so absorbed I forgot I was hungry. And so, that happened.
s054.sec60.u9: So the same weird stuff as outside is going on in here, too.
s054.sec60.u10: Oh? By trouble on the island, you mean everyone is becoming like my men?
s054.sec60.u11: Yeah. Each kind keeps to itself, and they lose their memories. Not everyone yet, but if this goes on...
s054.sec60.u12: Could someone be making this happen? Hmm... And if so, to what end...?
s054.sec60.u14: What can I do for the island?
s054.sec60.u15: We're building a city to bring the Digimon's hearts together. That's why we're touring the island: to find friends.
s054.sec60.u16: I see. But that is a problem. Apart from me, my men are good for little else but fighting. And yet I cannot simply leave them behind...
s054.sec60.u18: I shall give you an answer in time. I have work to do here, you see. I truly am sorry...
s054.sec60.u19: Okay. I'll come back, then. And make sure you eat properly!
s054.sec60.u20: Then why not fight in the Arena?
s054.sec60.u21: Oh... the Arena? Now that is interesting. Just the thing to whip my men into shape. And I would like to stretch my legs now and then myself.
s054.sec60.u23: Yes. I still have some research to finish here, though, so I will come to the city between my studies. I look forward to it.
s054.sec81.u1: Yes, a key! Maybe this opens those doors that wouldn't open.
s054.sec81.u3: Oops, I need to throw something out.
s055.sec83.u1: "Go back to where you took points from the fool."
s055.sec83.u3: Huh? It's not here? It's gone?
s055.sec83.u4: Oh? There's a note stuck on it...
s055.sec83.u5: "Go back to where you took points from the fool."
s055.sec83.u6: Hm, looks like this note is all I've got to go on for now. Hmm.
s055.sec83.u8: Ugh, it's locked. Who locks a fridge?
s061.sec52.u2: Looks like we got into a room we've never been in.
s061.sec82.u1: Does it open if I turn this knob?
s062.sec81.u0: What's all this? Any books I can read...?
s062.sec81.u1: Nope. Not a single one. Hm, but there's one book with a really fancy cover!
s062.sec81.u5: It might be some kind of trap... Better not.
